recommendation: Provide comprehensive social needs assessment and resource navigation for food insecurity
implementation_steps: Assess broader social determinants affecting food security status
Assist with applications for federal nutrition programs like SNAP and WIC
Coordinate with community food resources including food banks and pantries
Address underlying factors contributing to food insecurity
Follow up to ensure successful connection to resources
evidence_summary: Social worker-led interventions addressing food insecurity have demonstrated improvements in food security status, benefits enrollment, and health outcomes, particularly when addressing multiple social determinants simultaneously.
